entities.name: Q5KW28 tRNA methyltransferase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Geobacillus kaustophilus tRNA (guanine-N(7))-methyltransferase; EC 2.1.1.33.
Transfers a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to guanosine at tRNA position 46, producing m7G46 and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

entities.name: tRNA G46 N7 methylation
observations: Guanosine(46) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(7)-methylguanosine(46) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine; Rhea:42708.
